q: How are emissions from making methanol calculated?
title: Methanol plant emissions per tonne
short: Use a carbon balance: carbon in the gas or coal fed in, minus carbon leaving in the methanol, is emitted as CO2. Coal-based methanol emits far more than gas-based. Add grid power at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25. Methanol is not a CBAM good today.

ol: Carbon in feedstock and fuel, from quantity and carbon content.
Minus carbon in methanol and other products sold.

p: Methanol is not on the CBAM goods list. Hydrogen is, so a methanol plant selling hydrogen should check that stream separately.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
